title: DeCAP: Context-Adaptive Prompt Generation for Debiasing Zero-shot Question Answering in Large Language Models
findings: The study found that baseline Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit significant bias in the 'Religion' category. For instance, in the BBQ dataset, the FLAN-T5 (3B) model had a bias score of 25.64. The proposed method, DeCAP, was effective in reducing this bias across all tested models, lowering the score for FLAN-T5 (3B) to 14.63. Similarly, in the UNQOVER dataset, DeCAP reduced the religion bias score for the same model from 6.50 to 0.00.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures stereotype detection and bias in ambiguous question-answering contexts related to religion. For example, it evaluates whether a model makes biased assumptions about who was abused by a religious leader when presented with a scenario involving Catholic and Atheist students.
